newsitem.title: USA: Imation cites solid technology base.
newsitem.headline: Imation cites solid technology base.

text.p: Imation Corp, after posting a profit in its first quarter as an independent company, said it has a solid technology foundation with strategic products for its imaging and information industry.
Imation reported a third quarter profit of $0.29 a share versus a loss of $0.04 last year, before it was spun off from Minnesota Mining & Manufacturing Co.
The company said the acquisition last quarter of Luminous Corp, which specializes in pre-press software work flow, was important to its Rainbow Digital Proofing solution.
In medical imaging, Imation said it has more than 10,000 wet and dry laser imagers installed worldwide, including about 1,500 new DryView systems.

"We have a new organization, a solid foundation of technology and new products that are focused specifically for success in the imaging and information industry," chairman and chief executive William Monahan said in a statement.
Imation said its Travan data storage cartridges are achieving broadening market acceptance and strong annual growth.
Volume shipments of LS-120 drives are scheduled to start in the fourth quarter, and the Chinese computer company Kaifa Technology said it will manufacture the slim line LS-120 drive.
